dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: No distinct horizontal bands visible; however, multiple high-contrast pale fringes on the greater and median coverts create a repetitive scalloped appearance.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp and distinct narrow pale boundaries are visible along the edges of the dark, folded primary and secondary flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Indistinct and non-linear; the uniform brownish color of the crown blends gradually into the patterned upper mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly repetitive, high-contrast scalloped pattern extending from the upper mantle down through the scapulars and wing coverts.
